newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY-WESTERN PROVINCE BEAT GRIQUALAND WEST 30-16.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-WESTERN PROVINCE BEAT GRIQUALAND WEST 30-16.

text.p: Western Province beat Griqualand West 30-16 (half time 14-10) at Newlands to set up a Currie Cup quarter-final match against Transvaal at Ellis Park next week.
Defeated Griquas have the unenviable task of travelling to Durban to play title favourites Natal.

Province were grateful to young flyhalf Lois Koen who goaled seven out of nine attempts for a personal tally of 20 points. The other points came from a first half try by prop Toks van der Linde who rumbled over from a tap penalty, and a soft score frm a lineout by lock Hottie Louw.

Griquas were right in the game up until Louw's score in the 67th minute. The visitors scored a fine try themselves in the first half through scrumhalf Abrie Pretorius, who rounded off a break by flyhalf Franco Smith.
Smith was also on target with the boot, kicking two penalties and the conversion of Pretorius' try. Centre Edrich Lubbe also kicked a penalty.
Western Province: Tries-Toks van der Linde, Hottie Louw, Conversion-Louis Koen, Penalties-Louis Koen (6)
Griqualand West: Try-Abrie Pretorius, Conversion-Franco Smith, Penalties-Franco Smith (2), Edrich Lubbe.
